name: Invisible Woman

abilityDetails.Dodge: Gelen bir temel saldırıdan veya temaslı özel saldırıdan geriye kaçarak kaçınma; Çeviklik ustalığı bu pencereyi genişletir.
abilityDetails.Perfect Block: Bloklarken gelen tüm hasarı sıfıra indirir.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Force Field: Gelen hasara karşı geçici bir koruma kalkanı oluşturur.
abilityDetails.Fragility: Gelen saldırıların kritik hasar oranını artırır ve blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Exhaustion: Rakibin kritik vuruş gücünü ve tetiklenme oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Aldığı hasarı %90 sınırlayan koruması bitince veya yere serilince görünmez olur. Vigilance veya purify eden şampiyon görünmezliğini kaldırabilir.
signatureAbility:
Vanishing Act
Invisible Woman turns Invisible at the start of the fight, but it is not Paused.
[10 - 60]% chance to turn Invisible whenever Invisible Woman is knocked down.
Whenever the Opponent Misses, the Force Field gains back [1 - 10]% of its starting value.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: While Dodging backward, Invisible Woman is not struck by attacks.
20% chance that a Block is a Perfect Block, reducing all damage to 0.
Physical Resistance decreased by -[916.67].
For each Debuff on the Opponent, Invisible Woman's Attacks deal an additional 4% of the damage dealt as a burst of Physical Damage.

abilitySections.title: The Best Defense... - Pre-Fight Ability
content: If the Force Field is active, Invisible Woman's Hits have +[2,111.8] Attack Rating, but also drain the Force Field by 5%.

abilitySections.title: Force Field - Passive
content: Invisible Woman starts the Fight with a Force Field. The Force Field's maximum strength is equal to [11,362.2] Health, and scales with boosts and buffs.
Whenever Invisible Woman would take damage other than from Special Attack 3, the Force Field takes up to 90% of the damage instead.
Physical and Energy Resistance are increased by [485.29].

When the Force Field runs out, it goes into cooldown for 20 second(s), after which it will reform at 100% strength. If the Force Field doesn't reform for any reason, it goes into cooldown again for 10 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Invisibility - Passive
content: Invisible Woman turns Invisible whenever she Dodges an attack or the Force Field is depleted.
Invisibility lasts for 2 second(s), but starts Paused if Invisible Woman is not Bleeding.
While Invisible, incoming attacks have a 100% chance to Miss as long as Invisible Woman is not Blocking or Dodging, and Critical Rating is increased by [5,107.14].
Invisibility is unpaused when Invisible Woman Blocks an Attack, an Opponent Misses, or an Opponent hits Invisible Woman.
When Invisibility expires, it goes into cooldown for 10 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Fragility - Debuff
content: Whenever Invisible Woman would turn Invisible, she places a Fragility Debuff on the Opponent, max stacks 50.
When attacking a Fragile Opponent, increase Critical Damage Rating by [44.72] and decrease their Block Proficiency by 10%.
All Fragility Debuffs are Purified when Invisibility expires. Whenever a Fragility Debuff is Purified, Invisibility expires immediately.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: If the Force Field is active, 65% chance to Exhaust the Opponent, decreasing Critical Damage Rating by [85.05] for 5 second(s). The Opponent's Power Gain effects are also reduced by 25% for each Exhaustion Debuff on them.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On the last hit, if the Force Field is active, add a flat 25% to its current strength.
On the last hit, if the Force Field is on Cooldown, 50% chance for it to be restored at 50% strength.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The first hit of this attack grants Fury for 9 second(s), increasing Attack Rating by [10,559], scaling with the current Force Field strength. Then the Force Field is drained.
If this attack is Blocked, Invisible Woman has a 50% chance to turn Invisible.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If the Force Field is active, add a flat 100% to the Force Field's current strength. If the Force Field is on Cooldown, it is instead restored at 100% strength.
Pause Invisibility on Invisible Woman. It cannot unpause for 6 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Vanishing Act
content: Invisible Woman turns Invisible at the start of the fight, but it is not Paused.
[10 - 60]% chance to turn Invisible whenever Invisible Woman is knocked down.
Whenever the Opponent Misses, the Force Field gains back [1 - 10]% of its starting value.
